how: Captured by running the pinned graphify binary in scratch directories (HOME=scratch, GRAPHIFY_QUERY_LOG_DISABLE=1, PYTHONHASHSEED=0). save-result files are random in their 8-hex token and time stamp; reflect inputs carry fixed dates, so their ordering is independent of the run date; prs ran against a fake gh that serves the scenario files, with updatedAt materialised as now minus days_ago; worktree paths are replaced by <WORKTREE>/<REPO>. diagnose runs scan a crafted source file (diagnose/scan_probe.py.txt) instead of Graphify's own extractor.
